svg.title: Handoffs as threads on a fitted two-coordinate plane
svg.desc: Each synthetic handoff is one thread plotted on the two PCA coordinates fitted to the training trajectories. Height is joint-space distance from that fitted plane at the same scale. The threads lie almost flat; an outside-family sideward example sits far above the plane.
svg.text: HANDOFFS AS THREADS / A LIMITED SKILL FAMILY
Height = distance from the fitted plane · outside-family RMS 8.910°
